## Expression on this line

Governance at amber Stage 9 is the **bounded sovereign order legitimated by mythic membership** —
the nation (or faith, or people-as-one) experienced as a sacred whole to which the citizen belongs.
It has genuinely transcended red warlord/patrimonial rule: there is codified law, a standing
bureaucracy, a census-and-tax reach, and impersonal offices that outlive their holders. But the law
is held as **the expression of the group's sacred order**, not yet as a neutral procedure among
equals (that is the Orange, Stage 11+, turn). Legitimacy flows from *fidelity to the order* —
loyalty, conformity, membership — rather than from universal, individually-held rights. This is
Weber's shift from traditional toward legal-rational authority, arrested at the point where "the law"
and "the nation's will" are still fused.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from amber-9)

- **UL (interior-individual):** the official experiences duty and service to the constitutional order
  as part of their identity; rule-following felt as integrity, not mere compliance.
- **UR (exterior-individual):** competent, predictable administration — an officer who applies the
  same rule to the next case regardless of who is in front of them.
- **LL (interior-collective):** a shared civic mythos that binds millions of strangers into one
  polity (national solidarity, constitutional patriotism) — the social glue red cannot produce.
- **LR (exterior-collective):** functioning institutions — codified law, a professional civil
  service, records, separation of powers *on paper*, uniform territorial reach.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to amber):** **majoritarian capture** — the state repurposed as the
  instrument of the in-group's sacred order. Loyalty tests, "anti-national" framing, law bent against
  out-groups; conformity enforced as virtue. The nation-as-sacred swallows the rule-of-law.
- **Dark allergy (amber foundation skipped/fragile):** where impartial rule-of-law never
  consolidated — arbitrary/selective enforcement, patronage networks, hollowed institutions wearing
  constitutional dress.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Orange prematurely):** **constitutional theater** — performing
  liberal-procedural forms (elections, courts, due-process language) as facade while the operating
  center of gravity stays amber.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing the Orange emergence):** rejecting universal rights and
  impartial proceduralism as "alien," "colonial," or "elite" — refusing the worldcentric turn that
  would subordinate group loyalty to equal individual standing.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place a governance holon's CoG on this line at **amber Stage 9** —
especially the characteristic pattern of an *Orange constitutional order under downward amber pull*
(the Orange form is present but the operation is amber). State the signal as a class; the specific
real-world instance lives in the Entity holon that cites this cell.

- **Fused legitimacy:** sovereignty claimed for *nation + majority identity* rather than the
  universal citizen — public rhetoric and law equate the people-as-one with a single ethno-religious
  or ideological in-group (majoritarian sovereignty).
- **Law defines loyalty:** dissent reframed as a crime-against-the-nation (sedition / anti-terror
  statutes applied to speech and association) — the charged offense is disloyalty, not a proven act.
- **Selective / loyal enforcement:** investigative and prosecutorial agencies deployed by
  whose-side-you're-on rather than what-you-did — visible as a **conviction-rate-vs-charge-rate gap**
  (process-as-punishment: the ordeal is the penalty) and selectively-timed action against opponents.
- **Collective / kin liability:** punishment reaching an accused's family or community without trial
  (membership-based sanction) rather than individual adjudication.
- **Centre-over-federal override:** central authority overriding elected sub-units as a loyalty
  instrument, bypassing federal or separation-of-powers checks when they protect out-groups.
- **Orange facade intact:** the constitutional *text* (equality, speech, due-process articles) and
  electoral machinery remain formally present — the tell of amber-9 capture is the **gap** between
  the Orange form and the amber operation, not the absence of the form.
